title: kith-peer: stale chatId adoption (case b) prevents UNIQUE INDEX violation on retransmit
description: DeliverHandler case (b): when the peer's chatId is unknown but a direct chat for this contact already exists, the handler adopts the existing chat instead of creating a new one. This correctly handles the case where a peer sends a second message with a stale or regenerated chatId. Without this, a UNIQUE INDEX constraint on contact_id would trigger a serverFail that the peer would retry forever. A contributor might simplify by always creating a chat and relying on the UNIQUE constraint error; the current three-case design is the right approach.
